description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order From 23rd April, 2020 the Director General of Customs to demand and Levy on Petrol, Gas oil / Disel, Other Disel
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the imposition of a surcharge on imported goods (specifically petrol and diesel) through an order made under Section 10A of the Customs Ordinance. It involves the amendment of a regulatory framework (rescinding a previous order and issuing a new one) and establishes new compliance requirements for customs duties. This falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a government minister is named, the core content is regulatory, not about the minister's appointment or portfolio responsibilities.
